importantAccountingFinding.issue: The current Top-20 benchmark can label stocks as MISSED even when they are outside TAGX's configured cap_smallunder discovery universe.
importantAccountingFinding.impact: Raw Early-Capture Rate can understate performance and contaminate missed-mover learning if out-of-universe names are treated as model misses.
importantAccountingFinding.requiredChallenger: Add benchmark eligibility classification: IN_UNIVERSE / OUT_OF_UNIVERSE / DATA_UNVERIFIED. Keep raw Top-20 reporting, but exclude OUT_OF_UNIVERSE from Adjusted Early-Capture Rate and replay-training targets. Do not change production thresholds from this single session.

correctnessBugFixed.bug: Asynchronous proactive peak state could be lower than the current evaluation observation, producing negative giveback and retention > 1.
correctnessBugFixed.fix: Evaluation effective peak is bounded by current observation; giveback is non-negative; positive retention is capped structurally at <=1; workflow now asserts these invariants.

marketCrossCheck.interpretation: Peak/Exhaustion memory correctly keeps these names out of actionable Early output despite successful or late detection.

reason: The invariant fix is correctness-only and does not yet have multi-session before/after outcome evidence. Final reconciliation for Aug 26 is still pending.
